name: Odette Dale

goals.text: win more land for their house

memories: Beatrix Goldcrest wrote to me as an equal. My own liege never has.
I took Beatrix Goldcrest's gold. There is no unknowing it.
Mabel Highfell called me to Highfell for the winter. I said I had a fever. I do not.
The Treason of Sunstone: Odette Dale finally rides to Highfell, between two lines of House Highfell's spearmen.
I was beheaded at Highfell for taking Beatrix Goldcrest's gold.
